name: Grants.gov (XML Extract, daily database export)
program: Grants.gov keyword search "solar agriculture" (federal notices, forecasted or posted), title-filtered
collect_note: Searches the official Grants.gov API twice a day for open or forecasted federal notices matching solar plus agriculture, kept only when the title shows farm, crop, water, soil, rural or solar wording; new ones wait for review before showing, because many also appear under the individual agency funders.
evidence: Grants.gov search2 API, keyword 'solar agriculture', forecasted|posted: adapter_check ok, mode calls, 12 items kept by the title filter (2026-11-20).
